summary: I recomputed every quoted number in f-20261014-060043-9a03 and f-20261014-060114-ee01 from probes_final and the trajectories. That covered force and accel_step R2, controls, margins, headroom-normalised margins (0.786/0.765 and 0.738/0.765), same-layer N=64 minus N=128 gaps (0.0863, 0.0528), val_mse_ratio and growth rates. All match to the quoted precision. Both verdicts meet expected_if_true as written in both seeds. All margins clear max(0.1, control_spread) and the random-init noise floors. No pipeline anomalies appear: step-0 margins are below 0.04, runs completed unstopped, and the two seeds are not suspiciously identical. The two new experiments are the data_seed 1 seeds 22-23 arms of the 12000-step test and serve open questions q-20261014-060114-be61 and q-20261014-061412-7f7e.

issues.message: The caveat that the N=64 values may be rounded or max-over-layers is resolved by the paired arm's probes_final. Layer-1 force R2 is 0.8662 (seed 22) and 0.8465 (seed 23), and layer 1 is also the max-R2 layer at step 6000 in both. The same-layer gaps are 0.0863 and 0.0528, both >= 0.04, so the flip condition stated in the confidence note does not trigger. The same holds for the 'approximate' gaps in f-20261014-060043-9a03's note.

'supported' meets the pre-registered criterion (both gaps >= 0.04). However, that criterion cannot separate the hypothesis 'gap size is a property of the model seed, not the dataset' from a dataset-scaled effect: the gaps shrank from 0.143/0.072 to 0.086/0.053. The confidence note acknowledges this. The finding should not be cited as establishing seed-not-dataset.
